label: Exact decoded-content identity RECORD_TRANSPORT_1
definition: ExactTransport K D means that for every message c in the named domain D, decoding receipt of its specified code yields that very c. The domain restriction is explicit. This is a functional round-trip condition and says nothing about whether c is true, whether the code was caused by the proposed source, or whether an actual observer has epistemic access to the maps.
note: RECORD_TRANSPORT_1 is sufficient for RECORD_TRANSPORT_2 by equality substitution. The converse fails on the explicit independent-tag control: truth is preserved while content identity changes. Exact-value reporting in CopyGuarantee uses this stronger condition because its target is exact recovery, not merely truth of an individuated proposition.
